name: astra
description: A quiet place for your local movie collection
author: Astra

scripts.test:desktop: npm run build && node scripts/create-fixture.cjs && node scripts/integration.mjs
scripts.test:playback: npm run build && node scripts/create-fixture.cjs && node scripts/create-av-fixture.mjs && node scripts/playback-check.mjs && node scripts/playback-check.mjs --compatibility
scripts.test:packaged: node scripts/create-fixture.cjs && node scripts/create-av-fixture.mjs && node scripts/playback-check.mjs --packaged && node scripts/playback-check.mjs --packaged --compatibility
scripts.package: npm run build && node scripts/check-player.mjs && electron-builder --win portable nsis --x64
